name: @epoch/access-projection-runtime
description: Epoch Access Projection Runtime service (W041): the thin typed HOST FACADE over @epoch/access-projection — policy registration + versioning, canonical record admission (opaque typed references to the W036 shapes), the TWO-STAGE evaluation pipeline (the W009 authorization gate denies unauthorized operations BEFORE any kernel admission; the kernel then consumes the sealed decision), projection materialization, audit emission with the evaluation-key replay discipline, and the derived projection-state projection. Every step emits access-projection:* events (W010-shaped, one object = one stream stream:access-<slug>, one policy = one stream, one tenant state = one stream) sealed by the kernel and pinned by REAL sealEvent parity tests. In-memory reference behavior: NO persistence, NO network, NO identity-provider or policy-engine integrations; core logic stays pure (zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied).
